## Policy
A 25 % no-show deposit cut no-shows from 18 % to 4 % in six weeks. Charge it at booking, credit it against the final bill, refund it if the groomer cancels.
- New customers only; regulars are exempt after their second visit.
- Refunds are automatic and never need a support ticket.
